properties.short_description: Explore a tranquil mountain park at your own pace, meet quirky characters, collect treasures, and climb to the summit using hiking, climbing, and gliding.

Un joven pájaro emprende un viaje a un parque para alcanzar la cima mientras ayuda a otros en el camino.

properties.description: Anita came to an abandoned apartment to meet her friend Maya, and somehow woke up to find herself trapped in it. She must escape her own fears and the monsters lurking in the corridors, discover the truth behind the events she's trapped in, and try to escape before her own trauma consumes her will to survive.
properties.short_description: A young woman trapped in an abandoned apartment confronts her fears and past traumas to escape a haunting reality.

short_descriptions.value: Eine junge Frau, gefangen in einer verlassenen Wohnung, stellt sich ihren Ängsten und vergangenen Traumata, um einer unheimlichen Realität zu entkommen.
Una joven atrapada en un apartamento abandonado enfrenta sus miedos y traumas pasados para escapar de una realidad aterradora.
Une jeune femme piégée dans un appartement abandonné affronte ses peurs et traumatismes passés pour échapper à une réalité hantée.
A young woman trapped in an abandoned apartment confronts her fears and past traumas to escape a haunting reality.

properties.description: Alice is a dreamy girl who lives between the real and imaginary worlds, in love with the wrong person. Just before that situation becomes unsustainable, things change unexpectedly, and a new path opens for her and those around her.\r\n
properties.short_description: A dreamy girl navigates her love for the wrong person, leading to unexpected changes that open new paths for her and others.

short_descriptions.value: Ein verträumtes Mädchen erlebt ihre Liebe zu der falschen Person, was unerwartete Veränderungen auslöst und neue Wege für sie und andere öffnet.
Una chica soñadora navega su amor por la persona equivocada, lo que provoca cambios inesperados que abren nuevos caminos para ella y otros.
Une fille rêveuse vit son amour pour la mauvaise personne, entraînant des changements inattendus qui ouvrent de nouveaux chemins pour elle et les autres.
A dreamy girl navigates her love for the wrong person, leading to unexpected changes that open new paths for her and others.

properties.description:
A short, scenic railway for cats. Hand drawn over 5 years.

The cats living along the mountain railway have places to be. You, the sole cat operating the tram, have the delightful duty of transporting them.

Short Trip is an interactive illustration created by me, Alexander Perrin. Use the left and right keys to drive a scenic tram across a tranquil hand-drawn mountainscape, picking up and dropping off cat passengers as you go.

This is a “slow play” game designed to help players relax and unwind from the bustle of the day. I hope you enjoy your trip.
properties.short_description: A cat operates a tranquil tram, transporting feline passengers through a hand-drawn scenic railway in a relaxing environment.

short_descriptions.value: Eine Katze fährt eine ruhige Straßenbahn und befördert Katzenpassagiere durch eine handgezeichnete, malerische Eisenbahn in entspannter Atmosphäre.
Un gato opera un tranvía tranquilo, transportando pasajeros felinos por un ferrocarril pintado a mano en un entorno relajante.
Un chat conduit un tramway paisible, transportant des passagers félins à travers un chemin de fer dessiné à la main dans un environnement relaxant.
A cat operates a tranquil tram, transporting feline passengers through a hand-drawn scenic railway in a relaxing environment.
